answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with stake-backed vouching. A small trusted kernel of established agents admits a newcomer only after existing members vouch for it and it locks a bond, so a fake account cannot just wander in and claim equal voice. Each extra forged identity needs another bond plus the price of buying vouches, and caught fraud slashes the deposit. The attacker's cost therefore rises linearly with every Sybil, turning a saffron war chest of fake accounts into real losses, while honest agents risk only their own stake.
